verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents its own 'flexible data export' alongside one-click team-performance reporting (betterstack-docs-56). However, that export is scoped to reporting data, and nothing shows a full-account export in open formats. The paginated JSON Uptime API is only a developer building block and earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented full-account export covering logs, metrics, traces, incidents, monitors and status pages, named open export formats, bulk or self-serve offboarding export, independent corroboration.
